Wave 4, FLV-4 — the class form of the vanishing, closing the campaign's mathematics. A finite dominant map is surjective (closed image + density), so the fiber over the missing chart point exists and deg F ≥ 1 UNCONDITIONALLY; the Riemann inequality turns any class of degree ≥ 1 − χ into an effective witness; the dévissage peeling surjections descend H¹-vanishing along effective subtraction; and the assembled CLASS FORM — for any class l and any θ of positive degree, all divisor realizations of l·θⁿ have vanishing H¹ for n ≥ n₀ — with witness-independence by the per-degree class-invariance. The Θ-vs-Weil-divisor bridge deliberately sidestepped: the statement quantifies over an abstract positive-degree class, so the consumer supplies its own fiber class and no chart-convention identification is ever needed. Plus the rank anchor h⁰(𝒪(D)) = deg D + χ(𝒪) under vanishing H¹ — the locally-free-rank input for the base-change engine. Frontiered with a recorded recipe: the internal dominance discharge for the constructed map to ℙ¹ (true by its η ↦ η construction, unexported — a small stalk-integrality brick or an export from the landed curve layer). (C2) CLOSED — Kleiman th:cmp Part 2 on the cocycle model: the plus-unit is BIJECTIVE over every field test carrying a curve point. PicEtAff.unit_surjective_of_section and the isomorphism relPic C (Spec K) ≃* PicEtAff C K (with the landed (C1) injectivity) — the étale-sheafification pair the representability route rests on, in exactly the form the degree/Pic⁰/Jacobian lane consumes. The close: refine the representing cover to a finite separable field extension (landed cofinality), then the effectivity theorem — a rigidified class on the curve over a module-FINITE faithfully-flat cover whose two double-cover pullbacks agree on the nose descends along the cover inclusion. The finiteness is honest mathematics, not convenience: for quasi-finite non-finite covers the bare piece-triviality is FALSE (counterexample recorded — a product of two localizations of a two-dimensional normal local ring with nontrivial class group), and the general faithfully-flat form survives with piece-selection as hypothesis. The moving lemma, divisor-free (the curve over the cover is not integral — the meromorphic route was unusable and replaced): an invertible module over the piece ring trivializes away from one element avoiding the finite fiber-prime set (semilocal Pic-triviality + prime avoidance + denominator clearing, cyclic-invertible-is-free by the dual-pairing trick), pushed through the algebraic tube (going-up on principal ideals — no closed maps, no images); subscheme triviality becomes a trimmed trivializing cochain by unit-preimage transport and unit-sheaf reindex-gluing. Overlap independence by the glued-unit coboundary and the landed coboundary-invariance; the splice assembles M with cg^*M = L per the kernel lemma's constructive mirror. Frontier recorded: the general-base headline via a descent-aware moving lemma (module realization with a θ-induced descent datum).
